_comment: 2026-09-19 revision. Set from a measured sweep over 5 years of 15-minute bars, not from defaults. The 2026-09-16 settings (entry_zscore 3.5) were unreachable: across 418 live runs and 1,922 logged z-score observations the lowest reading ever seen was -2.95, so no BUY could physically fire - that is why the bot went 2 days without a trade. It also only produced 9 round trips in 5 years of backtest. These settings are chosen for DATA COLLECTION at a survivable bleed rate, not for profit: the sweep found no profitable configuration of this strategy at Kraken's 0.80%/side taker fee, and the user chose daily activity over capital preservation with that tradeoff stated explicitly. See docs/strategy_review_2026-09-19.md for the full evidence.
